Resistance 3 + Con modifier to instinct-typed damage while raging reaches nothing: no classFeature carries whileActive, and none of the ten *-instinct features (animal-instinct, dragon-instinct, …) carries a resistance either. The lane exists — whileActive [{state:"rage",resistances:[…]}] with a "3+@actor.con.mod" formula (derive.ts substitutes @actor.<abil>.mod) — but it must be written on each INSTINCT feature, because this record cannot name the damage types; raging-resistance itself has nothing to carry.

A selectable weapon-innovation modification (build.ts inventorModificationOptions offers it) whose whole content is "your innovation gains the tearing, trip, and versatile S traits" — and nothing adds them. weaponTraits cannot express it: derive.ts reads weaponTraits only from db.feats, and the innovation is never bound to an inventory item (InventorBuild.modifications is resolved "for display" only). Needs an innovation→item link plus weaponTraits on class features.

The apparition spells and the Trickster's Mirrors vessel spell ARE delivered (classes.animist.extraChoices["apparition"] option carries grantedSpells + focusSpells), but the Apparition Skills — trained in Circus Lore and Fortune-Telling Lore while attuned, which the animist class text confirms you "forget" when the apparition is dispersed — reach nothing.
